instrucciones.plasticoPet: Rinse the container before disposing of it. Crushing it helps save space.

instrucciones.metal: Crush the cans and rinse them before recycling.
instrucciones.pilas: Batteries are hazardous waste. Never throw them in regular trash.
instrucciones.organico: Organic waste is composted. Separate it from the rest of the trash.
instrucciones.electronicos: Electronics contain hazardous materials. Take them to an authorized WEEE drop-off point.
